chapters.content:
# Queue reader

The reader pulls one order at a time from the queue and hands it on.

```python
def read_one(queue):
    """Block until an order arrives, then return it."""
    return queue.get(timeout=30)
```

> A timeout is set so a stalled queue surfaces as an error rather than a hang.

| Setting | Value | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeout` | 30s | `src/reader.py` |
| `batch` | 1 | `src/reader.py` |

Next, see [Ledger writer](02_ledger_writer.md).

# Ledger writer

The writer appends each order to the ledger and returns the new balance.

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    Reader->>Writer: order
    Writer->>Ledger: append
    Ledger-->>Writer: balance
```

```go
func Append(l *Ledger, o Order) (int64, error) {
	return l.rows.Insert(o)
}
```

Back to [Queue reader](01_queue_reader.md).
